definitions.explanation: The area or direction behind something or someone. A somewhat formal word for the space to the rear.

examples.japanese: {後方|こうほう}を{確認|かくにん}する。
{後方|こうほう}から{救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}が{近|ちか}づいてきた。
examples.english: An ambulance was approaching from behind.

examples.japanese: バスの{後方|こうほう}の{席|せき}に{座|すわ}ったら、{揺|ゆ}れがひどかった。
examples.english: When I sat in the seats at the back of the bus, the shaking was terrible.

notes:
{後方|こうほう} means the rear or the area behind. More formal than {後|うし}ろ, often used in driving, military, and public announcement contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {後方|こうほう}{確認|かくにん}: rear check (driving)
- {後方|こうほう}{支援|しえん}: rear support, logistics (military)
- {後方|こうほう}から: from behind
- {後方|こうほう}{注意|ちゅうい}: watch your back

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {前方|ぜんぽう}: the front, ahead (opposite)
- {後|うし}ろ: behind (everyday, casual)
- {後方|こうほう}: behind (formal, technical)

WATCH OUT:
{広報|こうほう} (public relations) has the same pronunciation but completely different meaning and kanji.
